gloss: plumbing work; water supply construction; waterworks repair

definitions.gloss: plumbing work; water supply construction; waterworks repair
definitions.explanation: Construction, repair, or maintenance work on water supply and drainage systems, including pipes, faucets, and sewage connections. Encompasses both residential plumbing and public water infrastructure projects.

examples.english: Water will be shut off due to plumbing work.

notes:
Combines ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧ (water supply, plumbing) and ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (construction work). A very practical term encountered in daily life — on road signs, apartment notices, and municipal announcements. The phrase {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{断水|だんすい}→断水：04518_dansui⟧ ("water shut off for plumbing work") is especially common.
